'''Basterosa's "Baby"''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Asharl panther/Legends|asharl panther]] who was trained by the [[Hidden Chain]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Basterosa]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. He was killed at [[Kessan's Landing]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] at the same time his master was.<ref name="TOR:CoC"/>
